'''Altar of the Fallen''' was erected on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] near the [[Imperial Guard Academy]] grounds. During the [[Revanite crisis]], the Altar was taken over by the [[Order of Revan]] and was protected by the [[Lance Squadron (Revanites)|Lance Squadron]] command walker.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Altar of the Fallen appears as an area on Yavin in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />
